app.title: Carthage Escape
app.tagline: A team escape room. Nobody can solve it alone!

home.server_down: The game server can't be reached right now. Please try again in a moment.
home.server_degraded: The game server is having trouble. Some things may not work.

join.title: Join a game
join.code_hint: Ask your teacher for the 6-letter code
join.nickname_hint: Up to 16 letters. Don't use your real full name.

lobby.waiting_for_host: When everyone is ready, your teacher will start the game.
lobby.status_waiting_ready: Waiting for everyone to be ready

game.result_wrong: Not quite! Talk it over with your partner and try again.
game.result_wrong_by: {{by}} tried a code, but the lock didn't open.
game.failed_text: The vault stayed shut this time. Great teamwork, try again!

lock.lock_intro: Only your partner has the manual. Tell them the colors and numbers you see!
lock.manual_intro: Your partner sees the lock. Ask them about the colors and numbers!

rule.sum: Digit {{digit}}: add up all the {{color}} numbers.
rule.count: Digit {{digit}}: count how many {{color}} tiles there are.

lock_and_manual.hint_1: The lock holder sees the numbers, the manual reader sees the rules. Read each rule out loud!
lock_and_manual.hint_2: Start with digit {{digit}}: it only uses the {{color}} tiles.

host.switch_to_login: Already have an account? Log in
host.confirm_delete: Delete this game and everything recorded about it?
host.session_code_hint: Players open {{url}} and type this code.
host.confirm_remove: Remove {{nickname}} from this game? Their seat becomes free.
host.start_hint_ready: Waiting for every player to be connected and ready.

errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.room_not_found: No game with this code. Check the code with your teacher.
errors.nickname_invalid: Please choose a different nickname (letters and numbers, up to 16).
errors.nickname_taken: Someone in this game already has that nickname. Pick another one!
errors.too_many_requests: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.

ws_errors.bad_message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ws_errors.not_host: Only the host can do that.
ws_errors.players_not_ready: Every player must be connected and ready.
ws_errors.not_running: The game isn't running right now.
ws_errors.stale_puzzle: That puzzle is already done. Look at the new one!
ws_errors.invalid_action: That didn't work. Check the code and try again.
ws_errors.invalid_token: Your game pass has expired. Join again with the code and the same nickname.
ws_errors.replaced: You opened this game in another tab or device.
ws_errors.removed: The host removed you from this game.
